components.note: 氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 浮 is floating on water.
孚 (fú) — same sound: 浮 fú. 孚 also sounds out 俘 fú and 孵 fū.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 叮 is a sound, a sting or a reminder, as in 叮嘱 urge.
丁 (dīng) — same sound: 叮 dīng. 丁 also sounds out 钉 dīng and 盯 dīng.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 掏 is reaching in and taking out.
匋 (táo) — close sound: 掏 tāo. 匋 also sounds out 陶 táo and 淘 táo.
示 (altar) — marks gods, rites and blessings, as in 神 god, 礼 ritual, 福 blessing; 祭 is offering meat on the altar, as in 祭祀.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 浅 is shallow water.
戋 (jiān) — same sound: 浅 qiǎn/jiān. 戋 also sounds out 钱 qián, 线 xiàn and 盏 zhǎn.
风 (wind; traditional 風) — marks wind and air, as in 飘 drift, 飓 hurricane; 飘 is drifting on the wind.
票 (piào) — close sound: 飘 piāo. 票 also sounds out 漂 piāo and 嫖 piáo.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 柯 is a branch or axe handle; often seen in names.
可 (kě) — close sound: 柯 kē. 可 also sounds out 河 hé, 歌 gē and 何 hé.
力 (strength) — marks effort and force, as in 动 move, 努 strive, 男 man; 勤 is diligent, putting in effort, as in 勤奋.
堇 (jǐn) — loose sound hint (qín vs jǐn); same part in 谨 jǐn and 僅.
车 (vehicle) — marks wheels and vehicles, as in 轮 wheel, 转 turn; 轰 is the rumble of many carts, as in 轰隆.
见 (see) — 靓 is pretty to look at, as in 靓女; 青 hints at youth and freshness.
青 (qīng) — loose sound hint (liàng/jìng vs qīng).
讠 (speech; traditional 言) — marks speaking and language, as in 说 say, 话 speech, 请 request; 诶 is an interjection of surprise.
矣 (yǐ) — loose sound hint (ēi vs yǐ).
川 (river) — three lines of flowing water; used for rivers and streams, as in 四川 Sichuan, 山川 mountains and rivers.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 捞 is scooping something out of water.
劳 (láo) — close sound: 捞 lāo. 劳 also sounds out 涝 lào and 唠 lào.
足 (foot) — marks feet and walking, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump, 路 road; 跨 is striding or stepping over.
夸 (kuā) — close sound: 跨 kuà. 夸 also sounds out 垮 kuǎ and 挎 kuà.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嗷 imitates wailing or howling.
敖 (áo) — same sound: 嗷 áo. 敖 also sounds out 熬 áo and 傲 ào.
黑 (black) — marks black and dark colors, as in 墨 ink; 黛 is the dark-blue pigment for eyebrows.
代 (dài) — same sound: 黛 dài. 代 also sounds out 袋 dài and 贷 dài.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 桑 is the mulberry tree, whose leaves feed silkworms; 叒 above shows the many leaves.
衣 (clothing) — 衰 once meant a rain-cape of straw, and now means decline, as in 衰老 and 衰弱.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and herbs, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 菜 vegetable; 茜 is a dye plant, madder; also used in names.
西 (xī) — close sound: 茜 qiàn/xī. 西 also sounds out 洒 sǎ and 晒 shài.
贝 (shell, money) — marks trade and value, as in 买 buy, 财 wealth, 贵 expensive; 贾 is a merchant, as in the surname 贾.
火 (fire) — marks fire and heat, as in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp, 烟 smoke; 炮 is a cannon or firecracker, as in 鞭炮.
包 (bāo) — close sound: 炮 pào. 包 also sounds out 抱 bào and 跑 pǎo.
鱼 (fish) — marks fish and seafood, as in 鲜 fresh, 鲨 shark, 鲤 carp; 鲍 is abalone, as in 鲍鱼.
包 (bāo) — close sound: 鲍 bào. 包 also sounds out 抱 bào.
钅 (metal; traditional 金) — marks metals, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron, 铜 copper; 锯 is a saw.
居 (jū) — same sound: 锯 jù/jū. 居 also sounds out 据 jù and 剧 jù.
米 (rice) — marks grain and rice, as in 粥 congee, 糖 sugar, 粉 powder; 粒 is a grain, used for small round things.
立 (lì) — same sound: 粒 lì. 立 also sounds out 笠 lì.
⺮ (bamboo) — a tube was first a length of bamboo; marks bamboo things, as in 笔 pen, 筷 chopsticks.
同 (tóng) — close sound: 筒 tǒng. 同 also sounds out 铜 tóng and 桶 tǒng.
门 (gate) — a wooden bar 木 across a gate: 闲 was a fence, and now means idle, as in 空闲 free time.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 伽 is used in transliterations, as in 瑜伽 yoga.
加 (jiā) — close sound: 伽 gā/jiā. 加 also sounds out 驾 jià and 架 jià.
心 (heart) — marks feelings and thought, as in 想 think, 念 miss, 感 feel; 愁 is worry or sorrow.
秋 (qiū) — close sound: 愁 chóu. 秋 also sounds out 揪 jiū.
石 (stone) — marks stones and minerals, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break, 磨 grind; 磕 is knocking against something hard.
盍 (hé) — loose sound hint (kē vs hé); same part in 嗑 kè.
刂 (knife; 刀) — marks cutting, as in 别 separate, 刻 carve, 划 slice; 剃 is shaving with a blade.
弟 (dì) — close sound: 剃 tì. 弟 also sounds out 梯 tī and 第 dì.
心 (heart) — marks feelings and thought, as in 想 think, 念 miss, 感 feel; 憋 is holding in a feeling or breath.
敝 (bì) — loose sound hint (biē); same part in 蔽 bì and 弊 bì.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 漆 is lacquer, a liquid sap, as in 油漆 paint.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 塌 is collapsing, as in 倒塌.
王 (jade; 玉) — marks jewels and gems, as in 球 ball, 玩 play, 珠 pearl; 瑜 is a fine jade, as in 瑜伽 yoga.
俞 (yú) — same sound: 瑜 yú. 俞 also sounds out 愉 yú and 逾 yú.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 横 is a crossbar, then horizontal, as in 横线.
黄 (huáng) — loose sound hint (héng vs huáng).
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — marks feelings and mood, as in 怕 fear, 快 happy, 恨 hate; 懒 is lazy, a feeling of disinclination.
赖 (lài) — loose sound hint (lǎn vs lài); same part in 懒 lǎn and 癞 lài.
女 (woman) — marks women and family terms, as in 妈 mom, 姐 sister, 好 good; 妖 is a bewitching spirit, as in 妖怪 monster.
夭 (yāo) — same sound: 妖 yāo. 夭 also sounds out 沃 wò and 笑 xiào.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 捆 is tying up a bundle.
困 (kùn) — close sound: 捆 kǔn. 困 also sounds out 睏 kùn.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 撬 is prying open with a lever.
风 (wind; traditional 風) — marks wind and air, as in 飘 drift, 飓 hurricane; 飙 is a whirlwind, as in 飙车 speed.
猋 (biāo) — three dogs 犬 racing: a running storm; same part in 飙 biāo.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 佐 is assisting, a helper, as in 辅佐.
左 (zuǒ) — same sound: 佐 zuǒ. 左 also sounds out 搓 cuō.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 沃 is watering, then fertile, as in 肥沃.
夭 (yāo) — loose sound hint (wò vs yāo).
土 (earth) over 火 (fire): the colour of glowing earth and flame, red; 赤 also means bare, as in 赤脚 barefoot.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 涨 is rising water or prices, as in 涨价.
张 (zhāng) — same sound: 涨 zhǎng/zhàng. 张 also sounds out 胀 zhàng.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 拐 is turning or making off with, as in 拐弯 turn a corner.
耳 (ear) — marks hearing and the ear, as in 聪 clever, 听 listen; 聋 is deaf.
龙 (lóng) — same sound: 聋 lóng. 龙 also sounds out 笼 lóng and 咙 lóng.
